name: feature-044-social-reflex-pending-address
description: Social Reflex — Pending-Address Marker: being addressed marks the target (addressedBy on ConversationParticipant), renders a guaranteed address line via the spec 043 perception bridge, forces + prioritizes the target's next cycle as a soft System 1 trigger (no HardTriggerFlags changes), decays with the conversation lifecycle, and emits address/acknowledge events for reply-rate measurement. Depends on spec 043 landing first. Issue #160.
